rows.en: ＊Eiji＊＠０３９＿０１Yo! Good work today.￥You're done training, right?
＊Eiji＊＠０３９＿０２Doing nothing but training￥day in, day out really￥stresses you out, huh.
＊Eiji＊＠０３９＿０３Hey, hey! ...I came up with a￥great idea. Wanna come along￥after this?
＊Eiji＊＠０３９＿０４All right!￥That's what I like to hear!＝＠０３９＿０５I just knew you'd be up for it!
＊Eiji＊＠０３９＿０６It's nothing weird.￥Hear me out before you￥start complaining.

＊Eiji＊＠０３９＿０７Here's what I've been thinking:￥this place is pretty big, right?＝＠０３９＿０８But every day we just shuttle￥between training and our rooms.＝＠０３９＿０９There's gotta be tons of places￥we haven't seen yet.
＊Eiji＊＠０３９＿１１So let's go explore, all the way￥to the far corners! Gotta see￥whatever there is to see!
－　Eiji and ； walk around￥　　　　various facilities　－
＊Eiji＊＠０３９＿１３So the gravity control room and￥stuff are usually locked, huh.＝＠０３９＿１４I bet you can't get in unless￥you ask, "Can I have a tour?"
＊Eiji＊＠０３９＿１５Hey, just like back there...＝＠０３９＿１６there are lots of off-limits￥areas on Alpha, right?￥Do you know why that is?
＊Eiji＊＠０３９＿１８Once this selection's over,￥they're gonna remodel this￥place...＝＠０３９＿１９and turn it into a kind of￥"station" for going from Sophia￥to Elan.
＊Eiji＊＠０３９＿２０Well, yeah, but I'm asking￥why they're doing it.
＊Eiji＊＠０３９＿２１Apparently, after the selection,￥they're gonna remodel this￥place.＝＠０３９＿２２They'll make Alpha into a kind￥of "station" for going from￥Sophia to Elan.
＊Eiji＊＠０３９＿２３After this, following the path￥we open up...＝＠０３９＿２４tons of people are gonna￥move to Elan, I bet.
＊Eiji＊＠０３９＿２５Thinking about it like that￥makes me happy, y'know?
＊Narusawa＊＠０４０＿０１Is it true a mistake was made￥when picking these candidates?
＊Sakaki＊＠０４０＿０２Yes. Apparently a terminal of￥the central computer, Gaia, put￥out the wrong data.
＊Narusawa＊＠０４０＿０３We'd better not tell the￥candidates about this.
＊Sakaki＊＠０４０＿０４Agreed. Not in the middle of￥such an important test.
＊Sakaki＊＠０４０＿０５And Ryu was such a talented,￥outstanding sprinter, too...＝＠０４０＿０６It's such a shame.
＊Narusawa＊＠０４０＿０８Yeah. Well, you never know￥where life's going to take you.
＊Eiji＊＠０４０＿１２Ryu is... the first guy￥who ever beat me.
＊Eiji＊＠０４０＿１４He's... the guy who gave me￥my first loss...
＊Eiji＊＠０４０＿１８My head's all messed up.￥Sorry, but let's call it a day.
＊Eiji＊＠０４０＿１９It's almost lights-out anyway.￥Sorry for dragging you around.￥See ya.
